source: Synthetic host-package fixture generated with the tracked public litchi-iwa Numbers editor recipe
generator_command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 cargo run --manifest-path crates/litchi-iwa/Cargo.toml --example create_numbers_two_sheet_chart_font_size --offline --quiet -- /tmp/two-sheet-chart-font-size.numbers
generator_operations: Builder::build created the first sheet and table
Draft::add_sheet_chart added one standalone Column2d chart to each sheet
inputs: No external fixture inputs; the tracked generator constructs the package from typed data.
regeneration_note: The recipe is host-owned and is available through generator_source_commit. W3 deletion of litchi-iwa intentionally removes the recipe; the tracked fixture remains a migration-test input. Fresh generated package identities may change archive bytes, while the two-sheet chart/font semantics remain the asserted contract.
scope: Synthetic two-container identity/path control only; no native application acceptance or native evidence is claimed.
